mentions.name: LLM astrology chart exploration
mentions.description: An experiment combining LLMs with traditional astrology: an astrology chart generated as text is fed to Gemini 2.5 Pro, which answers questions about personal characteristics, proposes hypotheses and scenarios that fit the person, and applies the Primary Directions predictive technique to match symbolic astrological events to past and future life events for personal and professional decision-making.
mentions.source_excerpt: I've been working in the intersection of LLMs and Traditional Astrology, for personal knowledge, professional and personal decision-making, and mostly for fun.

evidence.value: I've been working in the intersection of LLMs and Traditional Astrology, for personal knowledge, professional and personal decision-making, and mostly for fun.
